assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean background plate for a cinemagraph. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. At the right is a wooden hanging bench swing on a black metal A-frame. Remove ONLY the hanging wooden seat/backrest/armrests and its thin suspension chains. KEEP the complete black A-frame: legs, top beam and support braces. Reconstruct the foliage and ground that were hidden behind the seat and chains. Preserve the gazebo, every tree trunk, path and lamp, all geometry, daylight, exact camera, framing and 1672:809 aspect ratio. The resulting plate should register pixel-for-pixel with the original. No other changes, no people, no text, no watermark.
